answer: Sybil resistance requires PoA registration to bind each agent to a remotely verified enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE) and its platform attestation identity; MRENCLAVE alone identifies enclave code, not a unique machine. A copied VM cannot forge a valid hardware attestation, so creating another accepted identity generally requires access to separate genuine hardware and its silicon-backed credentials, rather than simple duplication. Names such as terrace, vertex, and zephyr do not confer identities.
